messages:
Nina: quick thought - propose a 'staggered fallback' toggle: ramp fallback pct based on separate signals rather than single err_rate. helps when one signal spikes briefly.
Carlos: curious what signals you mean? latency, errors, and cost? :thinking: 
Nina: latency_p95, error_rate, and a new 'cost_surge' metric (unexpected token growth). each has its own threshold and weight. final routed_pct = weighted_sum clamped.
Rahul: love it. UX ask: show per-signal mini sparklines and the computed routed_pct in realtime. also a prominent "freeze" button that sets routed_pct=0 and logs operator id.
Carlos: audit needs: every decision should record signals snapshot + seed for randomness (so deterministic replay possible). even if sampled.
Nina: good call. sampling: compact-audit at 0.5% by default, full-trace 0.01% with anomaly boost. retention default 90d.
Rahul: cost preview before enabling please - median and p95 monthly delta. show estimates per-customer tier. ops-bot: will post a one-line alert to #eng-platform on any hard-escalation with link to the sampled audit row.
Carlos: small API sketch we can add to RFC later: 
```
rollout: { id, mode: staggered, signals: [{name, weight, threshold}], guards:{hard_escalate}, sampling:{compact,full} }
```
Nina: I'll draft the RFC and add a mockup. thanks all.
ops-bot: noted. created ticket PLAT-1309 for metrics and audit fields.
